content.label: Rental options and setup planning
content.html:
Rental planning

Built around your event, venue, and guest flow

Every rental starts with the practical details: where the rink will sit, how guests will enter and exit, where skates and benches belong, how the event will be staffed, and which upgrades help the experience feel complete.

Request planning guidance

Planning topics

  • Rink-size planning for your available surface and attendance
  • Indoor or outdoor venue review based on surface, access, and event needs
  • Skates, skating aids, benches, and guest-support conversations
  • Lighting, music, signage, snow-effect, and holiday atmosphere options
  • Staffing and operations planning for smoother guest flow
  • Package support for events that need additional rental items

content.title: How the mobile rink rental process works

steps.title: Tell us about your event
steps.text: Share your date, city, venue type, available surface, expected attendance, and the kind of experience you want to create.

steps.title: We recommend the right setup
steps.text: We review rink size, access, guest flow, rental window, support equipment, and add-on options that fit your venue.

steps.title: We coordinate the details
steps.text: Delivery timing, setup needs, staffing conversations, skates, benches, lighting, music, and other details are planned before event day.

steps.title: You host a standout attraction
steps.text: Guests arrive to a polished skating experience built to keep the line moving, photos happening, and the event feeling special.

Event settings the proposed package supports

Perfect for corporate and VIP experiences

A mobile rink gives companies, venues, sponsors, and brands a high-impact attraction that feels premium, interactive, and different from the typical event setup.

Designed for public spaces and holiday foot traffic

For shopping centers, mixed-use developments, resorts, hotels, downtown districts, and community destinations, an ice rink can anchor the season and give visitors a reason to stay longer.

content.title: Frequently asked questions
content.subtitle: A few clear answers before the quote request.

items.question: Can the rink be set up outdoors?
items.answer: Yes. Portable rink setups can be reviewed for outdoor use when the surface, access, weather plan, and event layout are appropriate.

items.question: Do you offer skates and support equipment?
items.answer: Yes. Skate sizing, skating aids, benches, support items, and guest-flow needs can be included in the quote conversation.

items.question: Is this a good fit for corporate events?
items.answer: Absolutely. Mobile rinks work well for employee appreciation, client entertainment, brand activations, holiday parties, and VIP experiences.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: Send your event date, city, venue, estimated attendance, available space, and rental goals. We will review availability and recommend the right setup.
